mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a weakening labor market, which historically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic growth prospects diminish.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or if the correlation between UNRATE increases and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real estate sales (HOUST) signals a weakening demand in the housing market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the broader economy slows.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals a strengthening supply side of the economy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings prospects improve.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or if the correlation between INDPRO increases and positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month, it signals a strong labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as consumer spending and economic growth prospects improve.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or if the correlation between PAYEMS increases and positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% in a month signals weakening consumer demand, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic growth prospects diminish.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or if the correlation between RSAFS decreases and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) is rising, it signals a tightening monetary policy with inflationary pressures, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as real returns are eroded.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or if the interaction effect between high FEDFUNDS and rising CPIAUCSL on negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is negative for two consecutive quarters and housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 5% in the same period, it signals a significant demand contraction, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as economic growth prospects weaken.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 negative for 2 quarters and HOUST decreases > 5%
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or if the interaction effect between negative GDPC1 growth and declining HOUST on negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
